metadata.description: AI job application assistant: reads your CV, scores it against job descriptions, runs mock interviews and writes cover letters.

home.title: From CV to offer — faster and with confidence
home.description: Upload your CV and let AI fill in your profile, score it against each job description, run mock interviews and draft your cover letters.

parse.title: Reads any CV
parse.description: PDF, DOCX or a photo — AI reads it and pre-fills your profile in seconds.

match.title: CV vs job description
match.description: See missing skills at a glance and how to improve each section of your CV.

interview.title: Mock interviews
interview.description: Practise with an AI recruiter and get feedback on every answer.
